title: Laamu ɗo joofnirde Joomiraawo yahri ko yiyaaka
intro: Daartol ina anndi laamɓe kala sifaa, kono seeɗa tan yamiri domen hono ooɗoo. Ɗo henndu nduu e hoore mum jaabtii yamiroore maɓɓe e gollotooɓe hay yitere maaynde yi’ataa ina ngolloo e nder deeƴre, ndee laamu nanndaani e laamu ko adii walla caggal. Kono hay laamlaamuuji ɓurɗi mawnude ɗii ina poti joofde – nde oo ɗoo joofni, goonga oo yalti ko e ɓuuɓri ndi hay gooto miijaaki sikkude ɗum.
clues: Mi hokkaama laamu mawngu e juuɗe Joomiraawo am, kaalaaɗo e nder kelle ceniiɗe.
Mi ronii hakkille e laamu mawngu e jibinannde yahdunde e am e dewal.
Mi yamiri henndu nduu, ndu yahri ko woɗɗi ngam anniyaaji am.
Tagooje ɗe gite gaadoraaɗe njiyataa ina ngolloo e les njiimaandi am, ina peewna kaawniiɗe ɗe njiyataa.
Punndi njamndi mboɗeeri ina ɓuuɓtoo e am, barke mo alaa ko nanndi e mum e nder suɓaaɓe Alla.
Nde njaltu mi e aduna, ɓanndu am heddii ina darii e sawru. Ko nde tagoore tokosere leydi ñaami e oon sawru tan, wonɓe e sara am ɓee nganndi mi rewii.

arabic: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verse: And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment. (34:14)
